name: Veil Of Fate
source:
You had a peaceful life on Earth.
Loving parents. A normal routine. A place to call home.

But everything changed.

No childhood memories. Just strange dreams, familiar voices, and a sharp pain in your chest...

You awaken in Orithya: a world that claims you were never human to begin with.

Surrounded by strangers who say you're essential,
the truth begins to unravel…

But you never asked for this.

Can you trust them? Can you even trust yourself?

And most of all… is there still a way back? 

[From [url=https://meybin.itch.io/veil-of-fate]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在地球上过着平静的生活。
慈爱的父母。一个正常的例行公事。一个可以称之为家的地方。

但一切都变了。

没有童年的记忆。只是奇怪的梦境，熟悉的声音，还有胸口的剧痛……

你在奥里西亚醒来：一个声称你从一开始就不是人类的世界。

周围都是陌生人，他们说你很重要，
真相开始瓦解……

但你从来没有要求过这个。

你能相信他们吗？你还能相信自己吗？

最重要的是……还有回去的路吗？

[来自[url=https://meybin.itch.io/veil-of-fate]itch.io[/url]]
